title: Ratiator Demo finally out!
author: AkandoGames
selftext:
In Ratiator you program the tactics of your rats in a simplified visual programming language that is best compared to unreal blueprints. You write the code and your rats exectute them in the arena.

The Full game comes out on steam in January 2027 and is a deep tactical crew management game with permadeath.

check out the demo here: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5335480/Ratiator/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5335480/Ratiator/)

  
I changed the visuals of this game quite significantly since I first started working on it to a point where I now use more genAI than before. What do you guys think about the art in the game? The inital game had mostly my art with AI being used for multiplication but the further the game developed the more I developed tools to create a consistant AI Artstyle and eventually replaced many of my own artwork ... mistake in this ai-slop era? What do you guys think? Does the current Art scream AI to you?
